content.text:
I fixed all three problems in `src/queue.js`, and `npm test` passes (9 of 9). I didn't confirm that the new tests fail against the old code.

- **Hang after a failure:** a job that rejected never decremented `running`, so the slot was leaked for good. A job that threw synchronously or returned a plain value was also mishandled. Every job's outcome now goes through one path that frees the slot, starts the next job and checks for idle.
- **`onIdle()` resolving early:** it only checked that nothing was pending. It now also requires that nothing is running.
- **One job at a time after `resume()`:** `next()` started at most one job per call. It now loops until every free slot is filled, so `resume()` with concurrency 4 starts 4 jobs.

I added 7 regression tests to `test/queue.test.js`:
- A rejecting job doesn't stop the queue.
- Sync throws and plain return values work.
- `onIdle()` waits for running jobs.
- `onIdle()` resolves immediately when idle.
- Multiple `onIdle()` waiters all resolve.
- `resume()` fills every free slot, with peak concurrency 4.
- `pause()` lets running jobs finish but starts no new ones.
